en.title: Adventure Time Complete Series Box Set Hits New Low for Prime Day
en.summary: The beloved animated series, **Adventure Time**, is available at an unprecedented price this Prime Day. Fans can grab the entire run of Finn and Jake's epic adventures for a fraction of its usual cost.
en.body:
Get ready to journey back to the Land of Ooo because **Adventure Time: The Complete Series** box set has just hit a spectacular new low price for Prime Day. For a limited time, you can snag all 279 episodes of the groundbreaking animated series for an unbelievable $33. This is a significant drop from its original $50 price tag, making it the perfect opportunity for longtime fans to revisit their favorite quests or for newcomers to finally dive into one of the most influential shows of the 2010s.

The **Adventure Time: The Complete Series** box set isn't just a collection of episodes; it's a meticulously crafted tribute to the world created by **Pendleton Ward**. Across 22 discs, you'll find every adventure featuring Finn the Human and Jake the Dog, from their earliest exploits to their emotionally resonant finale. The packaging itself is a highlight, designed to resemble the Enchiridion, the semi-cursed magical tome from the show, making it a standout piece for any fan's collection.

## A Treasure Trove of Features

Beyond the complete series, this special edition includes a treasure trove of bonus content that offers deep dives into the show's creation. Notably, the set features the Minecraft crossover episode, "Diamonds and Lemons," a fan-favorite moment that brought together two distinct worlds. The bonus materials also include a variety of featurettes, behind-the-scenes clips, animatics, music videos, and special features from previous releases. These extras chronicle the *Adventure Time* process, offering insights into the animation, storytelling, and the creative minds behind the magic that captivated audiences for years. It’s a comprehensive package for anyone who wants to understand the journey of this beloved franchise.

## Why This Matters to Ooo's Biggest Fans

**Adventure Time** started as a quirky satire of the fantasy genre but evolved into a deeply layered narrative with complex characters and multi-season story arcs. Its ability to blend humor, heartfelt emotion, and surprisingly mature themes resonated with a global audience, fostering a passionate fanbase that continues to celebrate the series through its numerous spin-offs like *Distant Lands* and *Fionna and Cake*. This Prime Day deal represents more than just a discount; it's a chance for the community to reconnect with the show that shaped their viewing habits and offered a unique, optimistic perspective on friendship and adventure. Seeing the complete series at such an accessible price point is a testament to its enduring legacy and the ongoing love fans have for Finn, Jake, and the entire world of Ooo.

## What's Next

This Prime Day deal on the **Adventure Time: The Complete Series** box set is expected to last only as long as the sale event. Fans eager to own this comprehensive collection should act quickly to secure it at the discounted price of $33 before the offer expires. Information regarding future sales or restocks has not yet been announced.
